section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one study (not explicitly labeled 'Study 1') involving 135 female undergraduate students recruited at a university in Greater London. Mean age was 23.74 (SD = 5.78) and mean self-reported BMI was 22.15 (SD = 2.80); ethnic composition was 45.2% European Caucasian, 23.7% Asian, 11.9% African Caribbean, and 19.3% other. Participants are described as undergraduates (therefore coded here as 100% college or higher); no survey method, body appreciation assessment, or BMI–body appreciation correlation is reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: The participants of this study were 135 women enrolled in various undergraduate degree courses at a university in Greater London. Participants ranged in age from 17 to 51 years (M = 23.74, SD = 5.78) and in self-reported body mass index (BMI) from 17.15 to 33.27 kg/m2 (M = 22.15, SD = 2.80). Of the total sample, 45.2% were of European Caucasian descent, 23.7% were of Asian descent, 11.9% were of African Caribbean descent, and 19.3% were of some other ancestry.
